texts.uz: Kameraga tushmasdan, bitta mavzudan video yarating. Mavzuni yozasiz, Nightshift esa ssenariy yozadi, diktor ovozini qoʻshadi, tasvirlarni jamlaydi va subtitrlar tayyorlaydi, hammasi bir joyda. Ish boshlanishidan oldin taxminiy narxni kreditlarda koʻrasiz.
texts.ru: Сделайте видео по теме, не показываясь в кадре. Вы вводите тему, а Nightshift пишет сценарий, добавляет озвучку, собирает видеоряд и делает субтитры, и всё это в одном месте. Примерную цену в кредитах вы видите до начала работы.
texts.en: Make a faceless video from just a topic. Type the topic and Nightshift writes the script, adds a voiceover, puts the visuals together and makes the captions, all in one place. You see the estimated price in credits before anything starts.

evidence.claim: The public site says Nightshift writes, voices and edits a YouTube video from a topic, then waits for the owner's OK.
One pipeline run produces the script, the narration, the visuals and the captions of a video.
The narration is rendered by the audio mixer, in the channel's configured voice.
The captions are generated word by word by the subtitle generator.
The Create page takes a topic and the run's controls, and asks for confirmation with the estimated price shown before anything is spent.
The Pricing page is public and lists credits and plans.
